_comment: How the data plane refuses a capability, which the server and both SDKs' fakes are held to: each case is one capability, issued to the fake's tenant with the caveats named (audience ["data"] and ops ["get", "manage"] when none are), presented to the calls in order, each with the answer it gets — none when it succeeds. get_object reads the fake's object at key in its default collection; ensure_tenant_storage asks for a bucket. In a message, {object} is that object's resource URI and {elsewhere} the prefix of another collection of the tenant, object://<tenant>/elsewhere/. Codes are Connect's, reasons the ErrorInfo's.

cases.name: no resource under a resource-restricted capability

calls.message: resource not allowed: operation "manage" is not bound to a resource, and the capability is resource-restricted
